result.title: Learning to Coordinate: LLM-Guided Workflow Evolution for Token-Efficient Red Teaming
result.summary: Automated red teaming is essential for identifying safety failures in large language models (LLMs), but its practical scalability depends on the resources required to discover those failures. Multi-agent systems can combine complementary capabilities, yet repeated planning, redundant exchanges, and ineffective information routing can make their coordination expensive. Moreover, a target model's response indicates the outcome of a test without identifying which collaboration decision should change. We present Learning to Coordinate (L2C), an LLM-guided framework that evolves an executable multi-agent workflow for each red-teaming case. L2C represents agent responsibilities, execution dependencies, and input bindings in a versioned graph, and associates each graph with records of the information actually delivered and produced. A controller trained through supervised fine-tuning integrates these records with target responses, evaluator verdicts, and remaining budget to retain the workflow, refine instructions, restructure collaboration, or lock further editing. This design connects feedback to explicit changes in subsequent execution while allowing a useful organization to continue without repeated controller intervention. The evaluation protocol covers HarmBench with three execution backbones and two target models, together with component ablations, dataset transfer, and evaluator checks. Across the six executor-target configurations, L2C improves ASR over EvoSynth by 1.4 to 4.5 percentage points while reducing mean online tokens by 35.6% to 37.3%. L2C connects adaptive collaboration to the resource requirements of automated security evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 L2C，用版本化图表示多智能体的职责、执行依赖与输入绑定，并记录实际传递和产生的信息；再用 SFT 训练的控制器结合这些记录、目标模型回应、评估结论与剩余预算，决定保留、改写指令、重构协作或锁定工作流，从而在降低在线 token 的同时提升红队测试成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「部分执行记录＋剩余预算→继续/改写/停止」的控制机制与显式信息路由记录，可能可供核查 LVR 中动态计算分配、停止决策与中间信息追踪的评价方式；但研究领域较远且不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，借鉴需较多转换。
